comment: gateGenerator.process(sample_time) is called twice per sample, once for the gtbool test and once in the output line, and Rack's PulseGenerator subtracts deltaTime on every call that finds time remaining, so a gate lasts half its configured duration: the knobs read 0.1 to 10 seconds and deliver 0.05 to 5. clockTrig.process is likewise called twice: the result is stored in gtCLK first, so the later call inside the poly-copy condition always returns false and only the button can copy. The reset jack's meaning depends on the cable, so it has no family.
